description_en: Queries the peak attack traffic bandwidth and peak attack traffic packet rates of one or more Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances within a specified period of time
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内DDoS高防受到的攻击带宽和包速峰值
name: DescribePortAttackMaxFlow

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的流量数据的结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的流量数据的开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

Bps.description_en: The peak bandwidth of attack traffic. Unit: bit/s

Pps.description_en: The peak packet rate of attack traffic . Unit: packets per second (pps)
